body.statement: Construct and characterize an evaluated representation implementing \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{mom}}\) such that every cutoff-forest message remains closed under arbitrary heterogeneous branching, forest-component products, moving endpoints at ordered core priorities, and zero-, one-, and two-tagged coefficient extraction, while its state count, arithmetic count, and intermediate rational bit height are each bounded by \(2^{O(k\log(k+1))}\operatorname{poly}(n,b,\lambda)\). The representation must match exact residual enumeration on every \(\Gamma_{k,m,M}\) instance with \(k\le3\), \(m\le2\), branch weights in \(\{1,2\}\), and all admissible tags, and it must have a symbolic arbitrary-\(k,m\) complexity proof.
body.justification: This operator closure is the sole nonstandard and genuinely open step between the exact core identity and a feedback-parameterized risk oracle.
body.gap: Existing tree recursions are scalar, and existing structural dynamic programs do not evaluate multivariate moving-boundary priority integrals with a fixed-parameter bit bound.
body.consumer: A solution immediately supplies exact WRI rule risks on any measured conflict graph with a small supplied feedback set.
